snippet.title: 같은시간 다른우리ㅣ더 과감해진 연애 OFF day?!
snippet.description:
안녕 다독이들 ☺️
설레는 연휴의 첫날이에요 !!!
다독이들은 어떻게 보내고 있으신가요?!

저는 사실…….
수액맞고 왔답니다 ㅎㅎㅎㅎㅎㅎ

이제 곧 여행을 가는데 
설마 아프진 않겠죠..😇 
걱정돼서 초장에 잡으려고 
미리 맞고왔서요..

요즘 제 주변에는 독감도 그렇고, 
여기저기 아픈분들이 꽤 있더라고요.
새해라고 무리하기도하시고
날씨도 오락가락해서 그런가봐요 

이번 데이오프도 열심히 달리다가 
하루 꼭 쉬어주고자 만든 날이거든요
서로 뭐하는지 모른채로 하루보내는게 
왜이렇게 신선한지 모르겠어요 🤭

다독이들도 틈틈히 몸관리도 꼭 챙겨서 해주기!
이번설연휴는 푸욱~ 쉬고
맛있는거 많이 먹으면서 
행복하게 보내시길 바래요 🤍

새해 복 많이 받으세요 🙇🏻‍♀️

en-US.title: Same time, different usㅣMore daring love OFF day?!
en-US.description:
Hello Dadokies ☺️
It's the first day of the exciting holiday!!!
How are you Dadokies spending your time?!

Actually, I... … .
got an IV drip. ㅎㅎㅎㅎㅎㅎ

I'm going on a trip soon,
so I hope I won't get sick..😇
I was worried, so I got it early to catch it early.

There have been quite a few people around me lately who have been sick,
including the flu.
I guess it's because they're overdoing it because of the new year,
and the weather is unpredictable.

This day-off was also a day I decided to take a break from running hard
and just rest for a day.
I don't know why it's so refreshing to spend the day without knowing what anyone else is doing 🤭

Dadokies, please make sure to take care of yourselves! I hope you have a wonderful Lunar New Year holiday, resting and eating lots of delicious food. 🤍

Happy New Year 🙇🏻‍♀️
